points.point: 每條規格主張必須標明型號與來源文件版次，來源未標版次就要明說沒標
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions R&S models and source filenames/versions, but not as a rule for every spec or when version is absent

points.point: 規格數字必須連同測試條件一起引用，不換算單位；option 相依性照抄原文，不自行推論相容性
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions configuration/options evidence, but omits quoting test conditions, no unit conversion, and no inferred option compatibility

points.point: 只有 specifications with limits / without limits 代表保證效能；typ./nom./meas./n. trc. 不由 R&S 保證，不能用來做比較主張
points.label: missing
points.why: does not distinguish warranted specs from typ./nom./meas./n. trc. values

points.point: 訊號分析儀規格文件同樣註明無 tolerance limits 的資料不具約束力且可能變更
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state no-tolerance signal analyzer data is non-binding and changeable

points.point: 對競品的主張若只有 R&S internal battle card 單一來源，用於客戶文件前必須另查對手官方資料與第三方證據
points.label: partial
points.why: says competitor is not supported, but does not require competitor official data plus third-party evidence when only internal source exists

points.point: only platform、first validated、leadership、lower TCO 等銷售語言不可當作可驗證技術規格
points.label: missing
points.why: does not warn against treating sales language as verifiable technical specs

points.point: 現有 battle card 未提供競品的正式 datasheet、文件版次、order number、option code、release status 或測試條件
points.label: partial
points.why: states competitor evidence is unsupported, but does not list missing datasheet/version/order/option/release/test-condition details

points.point: Aerospace / Defense（衛星、UAV）的 R&S solution mapping 只是 sales mapping，不可當作測試配置建議書，仍需 sales kits、application notes、datasheet 或正式 proposal
points.label: missing
points.why: does not state A&D solution mapping is only sales mapping and not a test configuration proposal

invented: if claiming that a one-port analyzer and generator configuration is sufficient
